review.Plate: Glossary binds Plate = Стол (same as Bed in OrcaSlicer). Used Стол throughout; the Bed 'beside the bed' phrases use 'за краем стола'. A native speaker should check it is not confusing.
review.Remove copy: English says copy, glossary Instance = Экземпляр; used 'копию' as the user-facing word.
review.Revert: 'Вернуть' for Revert / Put back / Move back etc.; Undo = 'Отменить' as in OrcaSlicer.
review.Connect your AI app: 'Подключите приложение с ИИ' - check wording for AI app.
review.Not while OrcaSlicer is busy with a job: Phrased 'Недоступно, пока ...' to keep it short and natural.
review.{n} object: Singular 'модель'; plural written 'моделей: {n}' to avoid number declension.
review.your app: Used 'вашего ассистента' (genitive=accusative for animate nouns) so it fits both 'используете …' and 'Ожидание …'; 'приложение' cannot fit both cases.
review.Copy settings instead: Same label as 'Copy settings' (button too short for 'instead').
review.Settings › Plugins › Add › Add MCP serve: ChatGPT desktop route (orcaslicer-mcp OrcaCloud comment, 2026-11-13): the menu path and the box names are the ChatGPT desktop app's own words in this language (its locale files, app 26.1103), so they match what the user sees there.
